API Shape

The doors under /bridge/. Pinned by the test battery: tests/snapshot.php → urls() is the exact door list.

Pages come from the CMS store (bridge/store.php, src/content/<type>/<slug>/index.md).

The doors

| Door | Method | Answers | |---|---|---| | /bridge/pages | GET | The page index — {type: [{slug, updatedAt, draft, hasDraft, tags, title, home?}]}. Drafts filtered for strangers, full tree for editors. | | /bridge/page/:type/:slug | GET | The page's raw Markdown (not JSON; Content-Type: text/markdown). X-Cache: HIT/MISS. | | /bridge/public/:type/:slug | GET | Public JSON per page: type, slug, title, bodyHtml (null when the cache is stale), children (siblings), files (page-local media). Drafts never ride along. | | /bridge/search?q= | GET | Authed text search over the editorial copies; same tree shape as the index. | | /bridge/session | GET | authenticated, user, role, csrf. | | /bridge/templates | GET | Installed themes with their manifest face: name, title, version, description, styles, defaultStyle, default, active, preview. Admin-only. | | /bridge/plugins | GET | Installed plugins with state. Admin-only. | | /bridge/drawer | GET | {handles: [...]} — the admin drawer's retail band (plugin handles + theme handles). Any authed session. | | /bridge/editor-blocks | GET | The canvas insertables of every enabled plugin. Authed. | | /bridge/pagetypes | GET | The fillable scaffolds from pagetypes/: name, title, body. Authed. | | /bridge/core | GET | The core's self-update verdict: current, latest, dashboard, updatable, error, localVersion, releaseName, published, contributors. Admin-only. |

The refusals

Statuses below are the pinned ones (tests/fixtures/baseline.json).

| Path | Status | |---|---| | /bridge/page/pages/no-such-page, /bridge/public/pages/no-such-page | 404 | | /bridge/no-such-route | 404 | | /bridge/page/pages/NOT_A_SLUG, /bridge/page/NOT_A_TYPE/hello | 404 — an uppercase identifier misses the route pattern; the store's own lid (Invalid slug/type, bridge/store.php) answers 400 only when it is reached | | /bridge/search?q=x | 401 | | /bridge/templates, /bridge/plugins, /bridge/drawer, /bridge/editor-blocks, /bridge/pagetypes, /bridge/core | 401 (anonymous) | | /bridge/plugin/<name>/<route> | 404 — unknown plugin or undeclared route | | /bridge/media/pages/hello | 401 |

Errors answer {"error": "…"} (Router\refuse).

The wall

The API is the ware's boundary: reads are open where they are safe (/bridge/pages, /bridge/page/…, /bridge/public/…, /bridge/session), and everything editorial or administrative — search, drawer, editor blocks, page types, templates, plugins, core — is closed behind a session, admin where the inventory demands it. The PHP core still never parses Markdown; the API serves bytes, or rendered HTML from the cache.
